entities.name: bearded man leading the lead ox
entities.what: Man with his hair in a topknot and a full dark beard, in a long loose robe tied with a sash; he walks east ahead of the second covered ox cart's lead ox, holding its halter rope low in his right hand behind him, his face turned east (picture right).
entities.src: 名画记: 牛拉大盖车 (pin 31)
entities.note: Leads the lead ox (t2's: ox at u ~10700-10960, head ~(10945, 960), traces back west to a second ox) of the second covered ox cart. Feet: west foot planted (10992, 1062), east foot stepping forward (11042, 1050). His group (cart, team) is t2's; join him to it. Body height head top to foot 194 px.

entities.name: man seen from behind at the road's south edge
entities.what: Man in a dark cap and a pale robe seen from behind, standing at the south edge of the road; only his head and shoulders show above the whips of the tall bare tree south of the road (no roof stands in front of him: the ridge of the tiled hall ends at about u 11050).
entities.vis: part: below the shoulders hidden by the whips of S4.tree.bare_tree_s_11075
entities.note: Foot estimated from body size (other road figures stand 160-190 px tall); the ground under him is hidden behind the roof ridge (v ~1085-1100). Could be walking east or west; the strokes give no legs.

entities.name: porter with two long bundles on a shoulder pole
entities.what: Man in a black cap and a pale belted jacket facing the viewer, carrying a shoulder pole across his shoulders at head height; from its west end (u ~11045) and east end (u ~11148) hang two tall, densely hatched dark bundles (rolled straw mats or bundles of straw), each about as tall as a man's torso.
entities.vis: part: lower body behind the slatted box
entities.note: The pole line runs at v 700-705 from u ~11030 to ~11230; the hanging bundles are at u 11030-11060 (v 668-800) and u 11135-11160 (v 690-790), centred on him. Readings: (a) a porter's carrying pole with two loads (preferred: he stands at the midpoint of the two bundles); (b) the line is the top rail of the fence/bank edge behind and the west bundle is a person in a dark hatched cape seen from behind (the restyle draws a man in a dark robe there). Only the shoe at (11080-11095, 852-860) shows.

entities.name: half-hidden man beside the porter
entities.what: A second, smaller face just west of the porter's, slightly lower, looking down-left; the body is hidden between the porter, the west bundle and the slatted box. Possibly a boy.
entities.vis: part: only the face shows, between the hanging bundle and the porter
entities.note: Face strokes at u 11050-11078, v 708-745 (eyes and nose readable at zoom 2.5). The restyle draws a man in a white turban here. Foot estimated under the face.

entities.name: youth bending over a tied bundle
entities.what: Young man with dark hair, a short jacket, a dark apron or wrap round his waist and trousers, bending forward to the west toward the slatted box; a long carrying pole lies over his right shoulder and slopes down east to the top of the tied bundle beside him, as if he is about to lift it.

entities.name: slatted box on short legs
entities.what: Small box or stand with slatted (lattice) sides and a flat lid, on short legs, set on the ground in front of the porter and the half-hidden man.
entities.note: Lid edge v 800-808 from u 11052 to 11095; legs to v ~850. About 43 px wide, 50 px tall. Could also be a carried food box set down.

entities.name: tied bundle set on the ground
entities.what: Tall rounded bundle (a sack or a straw-wrapped load bound with cords) standing on the ground east of the bending youth; the end of his carrying pole rests on its top.
entities.note: Spans u 11170-11240, v 800-880. A thin vertical stroke at u ~11165 (v 690-880) beside it may be a pole standing against it. The restyle draws clothes and bags hung on a post here.

entities.name: porters at the north edge of the road
entities.what: A knot of carriers at the road's north edge, west of the courier post and just east of the two sedan chairs: a porter with two long bundles on a shoulder pole faces the viewer, a half-hidden man stands beside him, and a youth bends to lift a tied bundle on his pole; a slatted box stands between them.
entities.note: They may be the luggage carriers following the two sedan chairs (t2, u ~10620-10880, going west with their bearers); nothing in the strokes ties them to it for certain. The rear sedan bearer (foot ~(10980, 836)) is t2's.

entities.name: soldier lying asleep on the forecourt
entities.what: Soldier stretched out on the ground in front of the stake fence, head to the west by the big willow's foot (propped on a box or bundle, or on his bent arm), body and legs running east to his feet beside the seated soldier; asleep.
entities.src: 余辉: 懒兵候主; 名画记: 递铺 (pin 29)
entities.note: foot = middle of the body on the ground. Head end (11320-11385, 598-630), feet end (11505-11530, 667-690); about 200 px long. Which end is the head is not certain: the east end reads as shoes, the west end as a cap or a raised arm on a box. facing_deg gives the way the head lies (west).

entities.name: box or bundle under the lying soldier's head
entities.what: Small square-edged object under the lying soldier's head at the willow's foot, used as a pillow: a document box or a bundle.
entities.vis: part: under the soldier's head and arm
entities.src: 余辉: 懒兵候主; 名画记: 递铺 (pin 29)
entities.note: Straight top edge (11320-11370, v ~600) and a vertical side at u ~11365 (600-625). May be the soldier's raised arm or cap instead; the restyle draws a white bundle.

entities.name: soldier dozing with arms round his knees
entities.what: Soldier in a dark cap and a belted jacket sitting on the ground with his knees drawn up and his arms folded over them, head bowed onto his arms, dozing; he sits just north of the lying soldier's legs, between the second and third spears.
entities.src: 余辉: 懒兵候主; 名画记: 递铺 (pin 29)
entities.note: Seated on the ground (no box visible under him). Knees at (11425-11445, 610-620); hips at ~(11500, 640).

entities.name: round-faced soldier squatting behind the document box
entities.what: Round-faced, beardless soldier in a dark cap and a jacket, squatting with his knees up behind the dark document box, hands together at his chest inside his sleeves, looking straight out at the viewer.
entities.vis: part: legs and feet hidden by the document box
entities.src: 余辉: 懒兵候主; 名画记: 递铺 (pin 29)
entities.note: Knees at v 625-640 just above the box top (v 645), so he squats on the ground behind it rather than sitting on it; feet estimated behind the box's back edge. If he sits on the box instead, his feet are on its top.

entities.name: document box (dark chest)
entities.what: Large dark rectangular chest with hatched sides and a lid, set on the ground in front of the gate's west post; the round-faced soldier squats behind it and the bearded soldier sits at its east end.
entities.vis: part: top hidden by the squatting soldier
entities.src: 余辉: 懒兵候主; 名画记: 递铺 (pin 29)
entities.note: SCALE CUE: front face from (11537, 690) to (11625, 690), 88 px wide, 45 px tall (top edge v ~645). Depth not drawn; base point is the footprint centre (est).

entities.name: bearded soldier seated behind the box at the gate
entities.what: Bearded soldier in a dark cap and a long jacket sitting just behind the east end of the document box at the gate's west door post, his right arm stretched east with the hand resting on a small stand by the open door leaf, his face turned to the viewer.
entities.vis: part: legs partly behind the round-faced soldier and the box
entities.src: 余辉: 懒兵候主; 名画记: 递铺 (pin 29)
entities.note: One shoe shows at about (11635-11660, 630-640); the other foot is hidden behind the box. His seat is hidden (the gate threshold, a low seat, or the box's back edge). The restyle seats him on the stand.

entities.name: small stand at the gate's west door
entities.what: Small low stand or stool with a plank top and short legs just in front of the gate's open west door leaf; the bearded soldier rests his hand on it.
entities.vis: part: west end behind the soldier
entities.src: 余辉: 懒兵候主; 名画记: 递铺 (pin 29)
entities.note: Top plank (11627-11675, v 595-605), one leg visible at u ~11660 down to v ~640. About 50 px long, 45 px tall. Not to be confused with the door leaf's lower edge just above it. The restyle draws a round stool with something on it.

entities.name: soldier hugging one knee in front of the gate
entities.what: Stocky soldier in a dark cap and a belted jacket sitting in front of the gate's east post, his left knee drawn up to his chest with both arms round it, his right leg stretched forward; face turned toward the viewer, idle.
entities.src: 余辉: 懒兵候主; 名画记: 递铺 (pin 29)
entities.note: EDGE u 11800: feet at (11768, 685) and (11818, 718), midpoint 11792 (just inside t3); head and seat at u 11810-11850. Seat not visible (ground or a low seat under his robe). The restyle adds a ghostly child in front of him; the scroll shows only his raised knee there.

entities.name: spear leaning on the stake fence (1st)
entities.what: Long spear with a narrow blade and a small ring or tassel below it, leaning with its head against the top of the stake fence and its butt on the ground by the lying soldier's head.
entities.src: 余辉: 懒兵候主; 名画记: 递铺 (pin 29)

entities.name: spear leaning on the stake fence (2nd)
entities.what: Long spear with a blade and a tassel at its head, leaning against the top of the stake fence, its butt on the ground just west of the dozing soldier.
entities.src: 余辉: 懒兵候主; 名画记: 递铺 (pin 29)
entities.note: Head at (11435-11445, 420-470), butt (11400, 642). SCALE CUE: 225 px from head to butt (about 2.9 m at 77 px/m in painted units).

entities.name: spear leaning on the stake fence (3rd)
entities.what: Long plain spear leaning against the top of the stake fence, its butt on the ground just east of the dozing soldier; willow whips hang beside its shaft.
entities.src: 余辉: 懒兵候主; 名画记: 递铺 (pin 29)
entities.note: Top (11525, 406), butt (11505, 642). A second faint line beside it (from (11510, 410) to (11490, 560)) is read as hanging willow whips, not another spear; if it is a shaft, the count is 5.

entities.name: spear with a tassel leaning on the stake fence (4th)
entities.what: Long spear with a knotted tassel or loop tied about a third of the way down its shaft, leaning against the top of the stake fence by the gate's west post, its butt on the ground at the document box's west end.
entities.src: 余辉: 懒兵候主; 名画记: 递铺 (pin 29)

entities.name: the idle soldiers at the courier post (懒兵候主)
entities.what: Soldiers of the 递铺 courier post idling in front of its gate: one lies asleep at the willow's foot, one dozes with his arms round his knees, one squats behind a dark document box, a bearded one sits by the gate's west door on a stool, and a stocky one hugs his knee in front of the gate's east post; four spears lean against the stake fence behind them.
entities.src: 余辉: 懒兵候主; 名画记: 递铺 (pin 29)
entities.note: Crosses u 11800: t4 holds the hunched dark figure(s) at u 11850-11950, v 600-715 (one or two soldiers huddled asleep), the furled dark banner on its pole (base ~(11865, 720)), the dark tapered object hanging on the gate's east post (u 11810-11828, v 490-548), and anything further east; join them here. Five soldiers are in t3.

entities.name: domed object on a low stand in the inner hall's porch
entities.what: Domed object with dense straw-like hatching and a smaller rounded knob on top, on a low stand under the eave of the courier post's inner hall, next to the yard where the white horse lies: most likely the horse's saddle with its saddle cloth set on a rack.
entities.note: Spans u 11725-11795, v 200-268 (dome 230-268, knob 200-230). Other readings: a man asleep curled under a straw rain cape (蓑衣) with his head as the knob, or a bundle of bedding. The restyle draws a saddle-like object on a bench.

entities.name: leaning pollard willow north of the road
entities.what: Big old pollard willow with a thick gnarled trunk leaning up to the west from the bank top at the road's north edge to a knobbly head, from which long bare willow whips fan out up to the top of the silk and hang down over the road group.
entities.vis: part: foot behind the bank edge / rail line at v ~700-710
entities.note: Trunk foot spans u 11140-11235 at v ~700; trunk rises to the knobbly head at u 11120-11200, v 340-480; a fan of whips also springs from (11060, 480). Its whips interlace with the trunk at u 10890-11050 (t2) and the willow at u 11300, so crown extents are approximate; the crown runs off the top of the silk.

entities.name: pollard willow at the courier post's west corner
entities.what: Big old pollard willow with a thick, mottled trunk rising from the bank top just west of the sleeping soldiers to a broad knobbly head; its exposed roots run down the bank face to the road, and its long whips fan up to the top of the silk and hang down over the stake fence and the spears.
entities.note: Trunk foot u 11262-11350 at v ~705; head at u 11200-11290, v 380-480. Roots splay from (11290-11330, 710) down to (11262-11335, 790): the forecourt the soldiers lie on seems to be a bank about 85 px of v above the road (v 790), so the trunk foot is on the bank top. The restyle turns the roots into a small figure; the scroll shows root strokes only.

entities.name: tall bare tree south of the road
entities.what: Tall leafless tree with many thin, upright, branching limbs (elm-like), rising from the bottom of the silk west of the big roof south of the road; its trunk is hidden in a leafy clump, and its crown reaches up to the road's south edge and screens the man seen from behind.
entities.vis: part: trunk hidden by the leafy clump
entities.note: Main stems converge at about (11050-11080, 1480-1530) inside the leafy clump; one big limb goes west to (10960, 1420). The restyle shows two trunks joined at the foot (11040-11090); taken as one tree.

entities.name: leafy clump at the bare tree's foot
entities.what: Dense clump of narrow, pointed leaves in sprays (bamboo-like) around the foot of the tall bare tree, in front of the tables under the big roof's west end.
entities.vis: part: foot at the silk's bottom edge
entities.note: Spans u 10985-11290, v 1470-1730. May be bamboo (the leaf sprays look like bamboo leaves) or a leafy shrub; the restyle draws a leafy shrub. The thin stems of the bush at u 11225 may be its culms.

entities.name: bush of thin bare stems at the bottom edge
entities.what: Low bush of many thin bare stems fanning up from the silk's bottom edge below the tables, under the leafy clump's east end.
entities.vis: part: foot at the silk's bottom edge
entities.note: Stems converge at u 11180-11280 at the silk edge (v ~1770).

entities.name: fan of reeds or bare stems at the bottom edge
entities.what: A tuft of long thin stems (tall grass, reeds or a bare bush) fanning out from one foot at the silk's bottom edge in front of the big building's slatted front.
entities.vis: part: foot at the silk's bottom edge
entities.note: Stems radiate from about (11620-11660, 1775). Another fan of thin stems starts east of u ~11800 (t4).

entities.name: small leafy shrub at the little bridge's west end
entities.what: Small shrub of dark leaf clusters at the west foot of the little bridge in front of the courier post; leaf clusters continue along the bridge's arched top like a climbing plant.
entities.note: Leaf dots at u 11690-11790, v 750-850 along the bridge's west end and arch. Could be leaves painted on the bridge structure itself (structures agent); recorded here so it is not lost.

entities.name: short post at the bank edge
entities.what: Short capped post standing at the foot of the bank edge in front of the sleeping soldiers, where the horizontal planks of the bank end.
entities.note: Post at u 11405-11415, v 745-788 with a cap at v ~745. May be a hitching post, or the end post of a plank revetment along the bank (then it belongs to the structures agent).

entities.name: figure in a doorway of the building south of the road
entities.what: Person in a long pale robe standing in a doorway of the building south of the road, facing the viewer with both hands raised to the head (tying a kerchief or a cloth over the hair).
entities.vis: part: feet hidden by the low sloping roof in front
entities.note: Between the door posts at u ~11715 and 11760, under the big roof's eave; a lattice window is east of the doorway (u 11780-11840, v 1490-1580). Sex not clear.

entities.name: large table under the eave
entities.what: Large plain wooden table with four legs set out under the front eave of the building south of the road, its long side facing the viewer; part of an open-front eating or tea place.
entities.vis: part: west legs hidden by the leafy clump
entities.note: SCALE CUE: top about 100 px long (back edge (11255-11355, v ~1540)), front edge at v ~1600; front leg about 47 px tall (v 1600-1647), back-right leg drawn from v 1542 to ~1600-1605. Footprint corners approximate (painted perspective is loose).

entities.name: bench west of the large table
entities.what: Low bench (or small table) seen at an angle at the west end of the large table, mostly hidden by the leafy clump.
entities.vis: part: legs hidden by the leafy clump

entities.name: slatted stand behind the large table
entities.what: Small box-shaped stand with slatted sides behind the large table's west end.

entities.name: slatted stool at the back under the eave
entities.what: Stool or small cabinet with slatted sides at the back of the eating place, behind the large table.
entities.note: Spans u 11281-11320, v 1512-1540. The restyle draws a tall stool and a basket here.

entities.name: slatted box at the back under the eave
entities.what: Second slatted box or stool at the back of the eating place, east of the first, under diagonal strokes that may be a chair back or something leaning.
entities.note: Spans u 11340-11372, v 1518-1542; diagonal strokes from (11330, 1480) to (11400, 1520) above it are unread (the restyle draws a round wheel-like object).

entities.name: bench set end-on under the eave
entities.what: Bench seen end-on, running back (north) from the front of the eating place, its near end with two legs toward the viewer.

entities.name: small table east of the large table
entities.what: Small square table with four legs and a stretcher, at the front of the eating place east of the large table.

entities.name: small table by the building's front post
entities.what: Small square table with a lower stretcher, standing just west of a front post of the building south of the road.
